evidence.claim: Read the authoritative entrypoint, configuration, application, and focused test owners.
AST inspection verified that streamlit_app.main constructs NbvStreamlitAppConfig and calls setup_target().run(); git status and diff checks were clean.
The concrete contract identifies streamlit_app.py as the CLI composition root, config.py as configured target resolution owner, and app.py as application runtime owner.

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/app/AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/streamlit_app.py; sed -n '1,130p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/app/config.py; sed -n '1,90p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/app/app.py; sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/tests/test_streamlit_entry.py; sed -n '1,130p' aria_nbv/tests/app/test_app_router.py"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/utils/base_config.py; sed -n '260,340p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/app/app.py; rg -n \"console_scripts|nbv-st|streamlit_app\" pyproject.toml aria_nbv/README.md README.md aria_nbv -g '*.toml' -g '*.md' | head -100; git diff --stat; git status --porcelain=v1"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; rg --files -g 'pyproject.toml' -g 'uv.lock' -g 'setup.cfg'; git status --porcelain=v1; git diff --check; python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib; t=ast.parse(pathlib.Path(\"aria_nbv/streamlit_app.py\").read_text()); n=next(x for x in t.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name==\"main\"); print(ast.unparse(n))'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; ls -la; rg --files -uuu -g 'pyproject.toml' -g 'uv.lock' | head; python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(\"aria_nbv/aria_nbv/streamlit_app.py\"); t=ast.parse(p.read_text()); n=next(x for x in t.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name==\"main\"); print(ast.unparse(n))'; git status --porcelain=v1; git diff --check"
